title: erigeron foliosus var. hartwegii
intro: Erigeron foliosus var. hartwegii, commonly known as Hartweg's daisy, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron foliosus var. hartwegii include expectorant, diaphoretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
